body:
Automated bridge job `RQ-REBASE-PHANTOM-4543` (pool: codex-personal), single commit on base `e78a1e0fd`.

**Tests:** no test command

**Tier-1 (CODEOWNERS) paths, async post-merge review:** .gitattributes .github/CODEOWNERS test/config/realio-lane-membership.mjs

<details><summary>Agent notes</summary>

# RQ-REBASE-PHANTOM-4543

Status: BLOCKED on remote publication and enqueueing. Local resolution prepared;
validation results recorded below. Do not open a replacement PR.

Existing PR: https://github.com/ashlrai/phantom/pull/4543
Existing fork/head: `masonwyatt23/phantom:codex-bridge/RQ-MERGE-FRIENDLY-1`
Observed PR head: `75ec886f455063ea6b53f2762668c0099c6d7711` (open, conflicted).
Worktree base: `e78a1e0fd182e8a118abeccfddf62d96b3d73baa`.

## Local resolution

- Reapplied the existing PR's registry sorter, derived top-level completions,
  union attributes and regression suite onto this default-branch checkout.
- Preserved the current default branch's help entries and subcommand values;
  sorted their layout and regenerated the CLI reference from current source.
- Fixed the observed hosted failure: Quick typecheck rejected the missing
  CODEOWNERS entry for `test/cli-registry-merge-friendly.test.ts` (a Tier-1 test).
  Added its owner entry. No Tier-1 closure snapshot was regenerated.
- Initial validation also found four missing owner entries already on the local
  default branch: `test/custody-wrap-receipt.test.ts`,
  `test/doctor-merge-path-cli.test.ts`, `test/merge-path-readonly.test.ts`, and
  `test/merge-path.test.ts`. Added their owner coverage as required by the same
  generated-block invariant; no existing owner pattern was removed.
- Registered that suite in the real-I/O lane because its fixture runs real Git.
- Local merge simulation conflicts were `src/cli/help.ts`,
  `src/cli/completions.ts`, and `docs/CLI-REFERENCE.md`.
- All changes remain uncommitted. No branch was checked out, no PR was created,
  no push/publish/merge/queue action succeeded, and no live installation changed.

## Remote blockers and handoff

`gh pr view` and `gh pr update-branch` both fail before contacting GitHub:
`failed to read configuration: open /Users/masonwyatt/.config/gh/config.yml:
operation not permitted`. The connected GitHub tools provide read access only.
No credentials were read or copied to work around that denial.

The job's final instruction prohibits commits, pushes, tags and publication.
Accordingly these are working-tree contents for the existing PR, not a completed
rebase or a published replacement. An authorized host handoff must update only
the existing fork/head through `publish.sh`, retain its ancestry, and check a
fresh Merge Gate before `gh pr merge 4543 -R ashlrai/phantom`. Do not use admin
bypass, force-push the default branch, or create a second PR.

Observed hosted CI run `42729828661` on the existing head: Merge Gate failed;
Quick typecheck's authority check had 8 passing and 2 failing assertions. Both
failures identified missing owner coverage for the PR's new test. This report
does not claim that hosted Merge Gate is now green.

## Commands and validation

- `pwd`; `node --version` — Node v22.22.3.
- `npm install -g @ashlr/phantom` — failed with EPERM at the global install path;
  existing `phm --version` reports 3.30.24.
- `cat docs/AGENT-MCP-CLI.md`; `phm docs --agent --json`; `phm help`;
  `phm mcp list --json` — used existing CLI onboarding. `phm wire status --json`
  returned exit 1: gateway not wired, several client configs inaccessible
  (EPERM). No editor configuration was changed.
- `gh pr view 4543 -R ashlrai/phantom --json number,state,title,url,headRefName,headRefOid,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,mergeStateStatus,statusCheckRollup`
  — failed reading protected gh configuration.
- `gh pr update-branch 4543 -R ashlrai/phantom` — same failure; PR untouched.
- Read-only GitHub tools: `github_get_pr_info`, `github_fetch_pr_patch`,
  `github_fetch_commit_workflow_runs`, `github_fetch_workflow_run_jobs`,
  `github_fetch_workflow_job_logs` — established PR state and hosted failure.
- Local read-only Git inspection: `git status --short`, `git log -1`,
  `git cat-file -t`, `git diff --stat`, `git diff --numstat`, `git show`,
  `git log HEAD..75ec886f455063ea6b53f2762668c0099c6d7711`,
  `git merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD c074463332a34f0ad0a6005c5a096d072018ab79`.
  The last command returned 1: the PR metadata's older base SHA does not contain
  this newer local default-branch checkout.
- `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD 75ec886f455063ea6b53f2762668c0099c6d7711`
  — exit 1, three expected conflicts; no commit or checkout was performed.
- `npm run install:worktree` — PASS; pnpm 10.28.2 install and donor healing.
- Restored the PR's three new files with Python `git show` extraction and
  applied the derived-completions prefix to the current subcommand table.
- `node scripts/sort-cli-registries.mjs` — PASS after extraction completed.
  An initial premature invocation failed because extraction was still running.
- `HOME=$(mktemp -d) node --import tsx scripts/generate-cli-reference.ts` — PASS.
- `node scripts/sort-cli-registries.mjs --check` — PASS.
- `HOME=$(mktemp -d) node --import tsx scripts/generate-cli-reference.ts --check`
  — PASS.
- A Node assertion compared sorted source help entries and evaluated subcommand
  literals against `git show HEAD:<file>` — 2 preservation checks PASS. The
  first attempt evaluated help templates without their imported constant and
  failed; corrected to compare help source lines without evaluating templates.
- `npm run check:docs` — PASS (261 local links, 400 source links, no errors).
- `git diff --check` — PASS.
- `HOME=$(mktemp -d) npm run test:ci -- test/cli-registry-merge-friendly.test.ts test/cli-registry-drift.test.ts test/cli-completions-subcommands.test.ts test/cli-reference-drift.test.ts test/authority-codeowners-310b.test.ts test/authority-tier1-closure-310b.test.ts test/tier1-apps-boundary.test.ts`
  — initial run: 39 passed, 4 failed (5 passing files, 2 failing files). Two
  failures were the four preexisting missing owner entries, added afterward.
  The other two are preexisting apps-boundary failures: all five files in the
  reported shortest chain are unchanged from HEAD, and the frozen HEAD
  authority snapshot already includes all three reported apps modules. The
  chain starts at `src/core/verse/outcomes-api.reissue.test.ts` and reaches
  `src/core/fleet/apps-recovery-invocations.ts`. No boundary test was weakened.
- `HOME=$(mktemp -d) node scripts/verify-changed.mjs` — initial run failed at
  authority drift (8 passed, 2 failed); stopped before its lint/typecheck stages.
- `HOME=$(mktemp -d) ASHLR_UPDATE_CODEOWNERS=1 npm run test:ci -- test/authority-codeowners-310b.test.ts`
  — startup failure: shared pnpm Vitest installation lacks
  `@vitest/utils/dist/helpers.js`; no regeneration happened. Updated the five
  missing CODEOWNERS entries directly; the Mason-only closure snapshot stayed
  unchanged rather than invoking the combined snapshot-regeneration command.
- `npm run typecheck` — PASS (backend and web).
- `npm run lint` — INCOMPLETE, interrupted with Ctrl-C (exit 130) after an
  extended silent ESLint run. Changed-file ESLint passed separately; the
  independently run real-I/O guard has 17 unrelated failures, so a full lint
  success is not claimed.
- `HOME=$(mktemp -d) npm run test:ci -- test/authority-codeowners-310b.test.ts`
  — PASS after adding the four baseline entries (6/6 assertions). Vitest's
  adjacent helper was available again; no further dependency changes were made.
- `node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js --no-warn-ignored -- src/cli/completions.ts src/cli/help.ts scripts/lib/cli-registry-sort.mjs scripts/sort-cli-registries.mjs test/cli-registry-merge-friendly.test.ts test/config/realio-lane-membership.mjs`
  — PASS, all changed JavaScript/TypeScript files.
- `npm run lint:realio-lane` — FAIL, 17 unchanged default-branch tests lack
  real-I/O membership. The new PR test is correctly registered and absent from
  the violation list. Kept the gate and unrelated test scheduling unchanged.
- `npm run lint:verse-sync-io` — PASS.
- `ps -axo pid,ppid,etime,pcpu,state,comm` — refused by host policy; no process
  arguments or environment were requested.

## Counts

Latest focused assertion outcomes across the seven suites: 41 pass, 2 fail
(preexisting apps boundary); CODEOWNERS recheck is 6/6 pass. The initial broader
run was 39 pass/4 fail before the four baseline owner entries were added; the
initial verify authority subset was 8 pass/2 fail. The owner regeneration
attempt had a startup error and ran zero assertions. Changed-file lint, backend
and web typechecking, documentation, reference drift, sorted layout, and both
registry-preservation comparisons pass. Full lint was interrupted (exit 130).
Implementation/test net LOC: +195 (+904/-709), excluding this report; registry
and reference reorderings account for most changed lines.

Companion tools called: none (`toolsUsed: []`). Connected GitHub read tools
are listed separately above.
